_about: Public-domain Henry Clay Fish (1820-1877), Baptist minister of Newark, New Jersey, for the Word Hoard: Primitive Piety Revived (1855), Harry's Conflicts (1872) and Handbook of Revivals (1874). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 67 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hcfish-primitive-piety: Primitive piety revived or, The aggressive power of the Christian church. A premium essay (Boston, Congregational Board of Publication, 1855)
hcfish-harrys-conflicts: Harry's conflicts : life sketches (Philadelphia : Bible and Publication Society, 1872)
hcfish-handbook-revivals: Handbook of revivals : for the use of winners of souls (Boston : J. H. Earle, 1874)

_excluded.hcfish-other: Anthologies he edited: History and Repository of Pulpit Eloquence, Pulpit Eloquence of the Nineteenth Century, Select Discourses by Monod, Krummacher and others, Heaven in Song; The Agent's Manual of Life Assurance (another Fish)
